finding.description: A short-lived busctl client cannot retain an owning bus reference after it disconnects. A fast transient unit may be garbage-collected before authoritative terminal fields are collected.

primaryEvidence.sections: AddRef handling and bus-track disconnect handler
primaryEvidence.supports: Transient AddRef is Boolean and tracks the bus sender; disconnect schedules unit garbage collection.
The official runner requests AddRef when using a bus-client connection.
Documented bus allocation, connection and reference/close lifecycle APIs.

recommendedLocalScope.transport: One persistent connection using explicitly bound host libsystemd APIs; no new daemon or Python package planned.
recommendedLocalScope.contract: New private candidate requests source-bound AddRef only for its own nonce-named diagnostic unit.
recommendedLocalScope.evidence: Retain connection through authoritative terminal, receipt and process-census collection; release owned reference and connection with bounded cleanup.
recommendedLocalScope.frozenSources: Preserve all existing frozen modules and candidates; update affected hashes only in new copies.

designReview.basis: provided official v255 evidence and planned design
conditions: AddRef prevents unit-object GC only; it does not retain processes, cgroup directories or counters.
Disconnect invalidates evidence continuity; no reconnect or rerun may be presented as the original continuous observation.
Per-call timeouts are not proof of an external hard deadline.
All existing identity, exit, census, resource and total-budget requirements remain.
